description: Source code implementing the GlobalFirstPartySets class, managing first-party sets, including methods for finding entries, computing metadata, applying manual configurations, and handling set normalization within the Chromium project.

classes.name: GlobalFirstPartySets
classes.description: Manages the collection of first-party sets, including entries, aliases, manual configurations, and methods for querying and modifying sets.

classes.name: FirstPartySetMetadata
classes.description: Holds metadata about a first-party set, including context and entries.

classes.name: SamePartyContext
classes.description: Represents the context of same-party or cross-party relationships.

methods.name: FindEntry
methods.description: Finds a FirstPartySetEntry for a given site, considering overrides and aliases.

methods.name: FindEntries
methods.description: Retrieves multiple entries for a set of sites.

methods.name: ComputeMetadata
methods.description: Computes metadata for a site, including context and related entries.

methods.name: IsContextSamePartyWithSite
methods.description: Determines if a site is in the same party context as another site.

methods.name: ApplyManuallySpecifiedSet
methods.description: Applies a manual set of first-party entries.

methods.name: ComputeConfig
methods.description: Computes a configuration based on replacement and addition sets.

methods.name: NormalizeAdditionSets
methods.description: Normalizes addition sets to eliminate overlaps.

methods.name: ForEachPublicSetEntry
methods.description: Iterates over all public set entries.

methods.name: ForEachEffectiveSetEntry
methods.description: Iterates over effective set entries considering configuration precedence.
